hero.headlineDynamic: organized by your personal AI secretary.
hero.subheadline: Your personal AI secretary for notes, meetings, and documents. Capture conversations, summarize complex files, and turn screen tasks into step-by-step guides — completely private, with no sign-ups or cloud servers.

demo.title: See HuskyNote in action
demo.description: Explore real-time call speech recording, local AI summarizing with Ollama, dynamic border-only document annotation, and structured meeting notes—all running locally on your device.

howItWorks.title: From conversation to organized notes.
howItWorks.description: Most meeting conversations are forgotten once the call ends. HuskyNote preserves what was said, highlights key decisions, and turns them into lasting notes right on your computer.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Speech recorded locally via your browser. Spoken words appear in real time with clickable timestamps.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Meaningful statements, decisions, and action commitments are identified without transmitting data outside.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Extracting task descriptions, assignees, and deadlines into an organized checklist.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Conversation becomes clean, durable knowledge saved to your workspace.

summaries.title: From messy conversation to clear action items.
summaries.description: Drag the slider to see how raw speech transcripts become structured executive decisions and deliverables.

features.title: Built for real everyday work.
features.description: Everything runs right on your computer. Private, fast, and works without an internet connection.
features.panelMeetingsDesc: Record meetings directly in your browser. Get clear transcripts, highlighted decisions, and structured action items automatically.
features.panelDocumentsDesc: Upload PDFs, Word docs, presentations, and text files. Ask questions across your documents, highlight passages, and extract summaries.
features.panelOperationsDesc: Record your screen during complex workflows. HuskyNote extracts screenshots, captures steps, and builds a standard operating manual.
features.panelAiDesc: Run AI models completely on your computer with Ollama. Ask questions across your notes, meetings, and documents without sending data to third parties.
features.panelAnnotationDesc: Easily captures steps and screenshots as you work to create clear, illustrated guides.
features.panelVaultDesc: All your notes, audio transcripts, and documents stay strictly inside your browser. Fast, offline, and completely private.
features.panelZenDesc: A calm, distraction-free space for focused writing with full markdown support, version history, and soothing sounds.
features.panelExportDesc: Export meeting minutes, guides, and notes into clean PDF, Markdown, or JSON files anytime.

setup.title: One command to initialize everything.
setup.description: HuskyNote includes an automated launcher that checks your local Ollama setup, enables browser permissions, pulls recommended models, and opens your workspace.
setup.checkOllama: Checks if Ollama is installed (prompts installation if missing)
setup.configCors: Configures cross-origin settings for local browser communication
setup.pullModels: Pulls lightweight models automatically if none exist
setup.startServer: Starts the development server and launches your workspace in browser
setup.supportedModelsDesc: Compatible with any model running on Ollama, including llama3.2, gemma, mistral, qwen2.5, phi3, and llava.
setup.privacyBoundariesDesc: Your notes and recordings never leave your device. AI requests travel exclusively between your web browser and http://localhost:11434.

why.title: Built for privacy, speed, and ownership
why.card1Desc: Everything is stored directly in your browser using IndexedDB. No remote servers ever read or store your content.
why.card2Desc: No tracking scripts, cookies, or analytics. Your notes, meetings, and thoughts remain completely confidential.
why.card3Desc: Export your notes, meeting minutes, and manuals to clean Markdown and PDF files with one click.
why.card4Desc: Free to use under the MIT license. You can inspect the source code, run it anywhere, or contribute improvements.

cta.title: Start organizing with your personal AI secretary.
cta.description: No account creation required. No credit card. Your workspace lives entirely inside your browser and local storage.

footer.description: Your personal AI secretary for notes, meetings, and documents. Everything stays strictly on your computer — no accounts, no tracking, and no cloud needed.
footer.privacyNotice: Your personal AI secretary that runs privately on your computer. No accounts, no tracking, and nothing sent to the cloud.
footer.licenseNotice: MIT License • Open Source • Runs on Your Device

dashboard.subtitle: Everything is saved privately on your device. Fast, offline, and secure.
dashboard.welcomeBanner: Welcome back. All recordings, documents, and notes stay 100% private on your device.
